page.layout: Two printed columns of Hebrew index entries under a title line at full width; a large ornamental rule and a block of faint show-through lines below; a right margin with partly visible letters and a page edge. Left column and right column read top to bottom. The right-hand margin letters are cropped and mostly unreadable.
page.notes: The Hebrew words are printed in Hebrew letters but are too blurred on this scan to be read reliably, so they are shown as placeholders. The left-column and right-column entries are printed side by side; the layout above pairs them only by row. The faint lines below the rule are show-through and the page-edge letters on the right are cropped and omitted. The dark ornamental row of crosses/fleurons is a printer's ornament and is not text. The word "Index" at right mid-page is a printed side heading; the faint lower lines are unreadable.
